name: frugal
description: Before your agent signs up for a paid API, LLM model, cloud service, SaaS plan, domain or anything else that costs money, it checks free tiers, right-sized plans and billing periods, startup, student, open-source and nonprofit programs, verified promo codes and cheaper alternatives, sized to the amount at stake. It never pays by itself.

interface.shortDescription: Find the cheaper honest way before paying
interface.longDescription: Whenever a task involves paying for something (a SaaS plan, an API, cloud, a domain, a gadget, a flight), Codex first checks free tiers, plan size and billing period, startup, student, open-source and nonprofit programs, verified promo codes and cheaper alternatives, with sources, then carries on. It never pays by itself.
